items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I played drums once or twice with him. ... And Hunter Gaudet, he played with Jack.

ctx.x: When did Gaudet die, before I forget it?
I don't remember when Gaudet died.
I'm a person to tell you, if you ask him. Recently or? Oh, quite a while back.
